config_facts.kubeadm_upgrade_invocation: kubeadm upgrade apply vX.Y.Z --yes (no --config) / kubeadm upgrade node

scope: BOXP-194 Decision Packet baseline aggregates. Read-only. Prometheus (monitoring namespace, retention 31d) via promtool aggregates; daily buckets are UTC days, the 2026-10-06 bucket is partial (00:00-10:05 UTC). Instance labels are mapped to CP1/CP2/CP3 (control-plane nodes) and worker-1..4 (workers; worker-4 is the GPU node). No raw logs, endpoints or credentials.

outage_runs_1min_resolution.method: 1-minute buckets of min_over_time over 30s scrapes; a run is consecutive 1-minute buckets satisfying the condition. Scrape gaps break runs. Node Ready counts come from kube-state-metrics, so a Ready drop can also reflect kube-controller-manager marking nodes Unknown after lease loss.

apiserver_all_3_scrape_down.interpretation: Observed from the Prometheus scrape path only (up==0 or series absent). Not evidence of API unavailability and not an upper or lower bound on it (metrics scrape can continue while VIP/readyz fail); no readyz history exists (no blackbox probe). Not used as a safety basis for D4. See apiserver_scrape_outage_corroboration.

degraded_runs_by_volume.method: longhorn_volume_robustness==2 at 30s resolution on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-04 (the only days with max_over_time>=2 in 5m buckets over 2026-09-04..10-06); consecutive samples with gaps <=60s form one run; duration = (last-first)+0.5 min.
degraded_runs_by_volume.note: Baseline contains no node drain period; degraded caused by a replica on the node being updated is treated separately (H6/3.3). Sample coverage (67 x 30s = 33.5 min) and elapsed run time (34.0 min, includes one bridged 30s gap) differ by definition; H6 threshold basis uses elapsed run minutes (max 13.0).

apiserver_scrape_outage_corroboration.method: 30s range queries over each all-3-down window (+-5 min) for up{job=~"apiserver|etcd|kubelet|node-exporter|prometheus-k8s"}, kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total (kube-apiserver/etcd/kube-vip) and rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[1m]). Counts are 30s samples (33 per window).
apiserver_scrape_outage_corroboration.reading: Prometheus itself stayed up and ingesting in all three windows; apiserver up==0 lasted at most 2 minutes per CP and the all-3 condition includes series absence; node-exporter on all four workers was also unreachable for 0.5-2.5 min in the same windows, so reachability from the monitoring path degraded cluster-wide. Restart counter increments for apiserver (2-3 CPs) and kube-vip (2 pods) were recorded within each window: apiserver increments +1.0 to +6.5 min after the all-3-down minute (09-17: +1.5/+3.0/+2.5; 10-01: +2.5/+1.5/+1.0; 10-02: +6.5/+2.0), kube-vip increments scattered from -6.5 to +4.0 min including some before the minute; counters come via kube-state-metrics so the actual restart may fall inside the gap, and simultaneity/causality with the scrape outage is not established. A control-plane event occurred within each window, but the extent of API unavailability via the VIP is unknown.

access.kubernetes_api: GET only (nodes, leases, pods, events, configmaps, prometheusrules, longhorn volumes)
access.ssh: read-only commands on the 3 CPs (free, meminfo, sysctl, manifest flag names, kubelet config keys, journal pattern count)
access.prometheus: promtool via admin kubeconfig exec on CP1, aggregates only; 4 batches of range queries plus instant queries; codex-review follow-up (2026-10-06 10:28-10:33Z) added 12 range queries (3 outage windows x 3 series, Longhorn robustness 5m-day scan + 2 days at 30s), aggregates only

quiet_window_30min_availability.method: 5-minute increase of etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total over the whole period; a point is quiet when no leader change occurred in the preceding 30 minutes
